items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: I think they would couple people together. So I was with Cedar.

ctx.x: I think that would be quite something.

Oh yeah. Well we had some kind of — I don’t know whether you call it a metaphysical or — something that happened to me on an airplane. It was really bizarre. And I mentioned it to him and he couldn’t believe it because that had happened to him and then I couldn’t believe that could happen to anybody else. So we had that connection right away. I remember talking. I think he’ll remember it too, because it’s something you don’t run into. But they put him together with, was it Gene Harris? I think they would couple…
I wanted to play just a bit of one of your tunes here. And maybe you can tell me—
